notes.title: Added VIVE and Index Support!
notes.notes:
RC Plane VR now has bindings for VIVE and Index! This means more people will be able to enjoy the experience of flying in an RC Plane in addition to our Oculus users. We really hope this update brings fun and relaxation to as many users as possible. Please let us know if you run into any issues or even have suggestions for bindings you prefer.

Thanks!
